title: Risk, Fraud, and Regulatory Intelligence Copilot - 45 Scenario Question Bank

wow_scenario.question: Why should I file a SAR for customer CUST-9821?
wow_scenario.description: Demonstrates full end-to-end Signal → Evidence → Regulatory Basis → 1-Click SAR Filing & Jira Integration.

expected_output.finding: Customer CUST-9821 triggered a high-risk AML structuring alert.
expected_output.regulatory_basis: FinCEN AML Structuring Guidance Section 3.1 & PMLA Section 12
supporting_evidence: Branch Locations: South Mumbai, Andheri West, Bandra East, Fort Main, BKC Plaza

tiers.description: Instant payment telemetry, velocity spikes, device switches, and newly opened accounts.

questions.expected_output: Transaction IDs, Risk scores, Fraud indicators, and supporting evidence.

questions.question: Which customers show structuring behavior today?
questions.expected_output: Customers making multiple deposits just below reporting thresholds ($10,000 / INR 10L) within short intervals.

questions.question: Show accounts whose transaction velocity is 5x above their normal behavior.
questions.expected_output: Accounts with sudden volume/frequency bursts compared to historical baseline.

questions.question: Which transactions deviate significantly from the customer's historical pattern?

questions.question: Identify newly opened accounts involved in large fund transfers.
questions.expected_output: Accounts under 180 days old moving large credit/debit tranches.

questions.question: Which transactions originated from unusual geographies or devices?

questions.expected_output: Accounts connected through shared device IDs or circular transaction loops.

questions.question: Which customers trigger multiple fraud rules simultaneously?
